name: Smart Blur
description: Edge-preserving gaussian blur: a threshold decides which differences are smoothed.

params.name: luma_strength
params.description: Luma blur strength (`ls`): 1 = full blur, negative sharpens

params.name: luma_threshold
params.description: Luma threshold (`lt`) in 8-bit levels: positive smooths only small differences, negative smooths only large ones, 0 = everywhere

params.name: chroma_radius
params.description: Chroma radius (`cr`); below 0.1 (default -1) = same as luma

params.name: chroma_strength
params.description: Chroma strength (`cs`); below -1 (default -2) = same as luma

params.name: chroma_threshold
params.description: Chroma threshold (`ct`); below -30 (default -31) = same as luma
